business_overview.revenue_model: Mobile game premium resources are recognized over the expected benefit period; APP Business is mainly advertising revenue.
business_notes: Revenue is geographically diversified: Asia 42%, Europe 34%, North America 20%, others 4%.
The PRC structured contract entities contributed about 3.06% of revenue and 7.21% of assets in 2024.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2024 operating cash conversion was strong, but 2022 was loss-making with negative operating cash flow and 2023 free cash flow after capex was near zero; use a material haircut for sustainable distributable cash profit.

gaps: The annual report does not split total cash by parent company, offshore subsidiaries and all operating subsidiaries, except for Chinese Mainland cash.
The annual report does not provide a precise restricted/free cash bridge by legal entity or dividend remittance path.
Maintenance capex is estimated from servers, computers and software; Fuzhou self-use office construction is treated mainly as growth/one-off capex.
